title: Handoff interview
description: The questions asked of someone starting a feature. Defined once here and read by all three surfaces that ask them: the terminal scaffolder, the Getting started page, and the generated agent prompt. Three copies of a question list is three chances to drift.

title.description: Heading for the interview, used by every surface.

summary.description: One paragraph setting expectations about how much this covers.

id.description: Field name in the collected answers. Unique within the file.

ask.description: The question itself, phrased as it is put to a person.

why.description: What the answer becomes. Shown alongside the question, because a question you understand the point of gets a better answer.

kind.description: How the answer is collected. 'list' is comma separated.

options.description: The allowed answers. Required when kind is 'choice'.

initial.description: Default answer, offered rather than assumed.

placeholder.description: An example answer, so the shape of a good one is obvious.

required.description: Whether the feature can be scaffolded without it.
